visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a cinematic montage of a woman in a white wedding dress standing in a brightly lit bridal salon. She is seen from various angles, including a back view showing the dress's low-cut design. (2) Two women appear close to the camera, smiling and gesturing excitedly. One woman has long dark hair and wears a white top, while the other has reddish-brown hair. (3) One of the women, now wearing a leopard-print top, walks through a luxury store labeled 'Grace Kelly', pointing at a large, ornate wedding dress on a mannequin. (4) The woman with dark hair speaks directly to the camera while wearing a plush blue robe. (5) A series of 'curtain reveals' follow where the woman in the robe opens heavy grey curtains to reveal her friend posing in different wedding dresses: first a sparkly ballgown, then a sleek mermaid-style lace dress. (6) A brief animated clip of a bald monk praying is inserted as a comedic reaction. (7) More dress reveals occur, including a short yellow puffy dress and a short white structured dress. (8) The two women discuss the dresses together; the one in the robe gestures emphatically. (9) The video concludes with the woman in the mermaid dress posing once more in front of the mirror, looking towards the camera.
